name: Glass Chess King Pawn & Personal Save
notes: Hint validates the live FEN, displays a five-second timeout error and shows the suggested SAN move
Hint highlights its origin and destination squares and draws a direction arrow
PNG board export and clipboard copy controls sit directly beside the board controls
Custom uploaded backgrounds and player/opponent profile pictures save locally
King Pawn answers chess topics, reads the current FEN and PGN, and can connect to a secure chess AI adapter
IndexedDB autosaves settings, images, games, chat and supports portable JSON save import/export
Cloud sync hooks are ready for a configured database adapter; automatic aunt-to-Mac sync is not enabled without a backend
